Melee combat specialist, acting on the front line equipped with heavy armor. The protection level and playstyle vary according to the chosen path.

A combatant focused on melee attacks and physical damage, acting similarly to the Warrior class. Due to its goblin biology, this creature has low defense and vitality, making it more fragile than traditional warriors.

A mage-style monster specialized in dealing magical damage and applying debuffs to adversaries. Because it is a magical variation of the goblin species, it has even lower defense and vitality stats than the warrior version.

A mage variation strictly focused on support, using spells to heal and apply buffs to its allies. It appears in more advanced stages of the story, acting alongside other monsters, and shares the same extreme physical and magical frailty as the Shaman.

A colossal threat that acts almost like a story boss, possessing defensive characteristics equivalent to a Guardian specialization Warrior. It wields a giant club, which grants it massive strength for its attacks, in addition to having high levels of vitality and physical resistance.
